latest_release.name: OpenEMR 8.5.0
latest_release.body:
## [8.5.0](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/compare/v8_4_1...v8_5_0) - 2026-10-26

### Minimum supported versions

- **PHP** 8.3+
- **MariaDB** 10.11+
- **MySQL** 8.4+

See the [tested CI matrix](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/tree/rel-850/ci) for all tested version combinations.

### Security Fixes

  - [Critical] Chained: a Front Office clerk escalates to whole-database read, a patient identity, and approved forged clinical records ([GHSA-vr7f-7c3w-49g7](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-vr7f-7c3w-49g7))
  - [Critical] OAuth scope canonicalization and containment flaws allow unauthenticated Patient read/write access ([GHSA-6xh3-fmm5-jjp4](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-6xh3-fmm5-jjp4))
  - [Critical] OpenEMR local file disclosure through user-controlled PDF HTML ([GHSA-h4xc-pqg3-8459](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-h4xc-pqg3-8459))
  - [Critical] Remote code execution via Stored ERA upload ([GHSA-r6wm-8m2j-c3q9](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-r6wm-8m2j-c3q9))
  - [Critical] SQL injection in openemr ([GHSA-hrf6-qx6w-vgh9](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-hrf6-qx6w-vgh9))
  - [Critical] SQL injection through CCR/CCDA approval patient-data field names ([GHSA-wh28-4qcg-5hcc](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-wh28-4qcg-5hcc))
  - [High] Arbitrary Global Configuration Override via Unrestricted User Settings Injection ([GHSA-v997-jphq-wvvr](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-v997-jphq-wvvr))
  - [High] Cross-patient C-CDA disclosure in ccdaservice/ccda_gateway.php (missing authorization) ([GHSA-6fxw-69cq-m7g6](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-6fxw-69cq-m7g6))
  - [High] diagnosis_full.php exposes unauthenticated billing delete and clear operations with user-controlled ID ([GHSA-r65f-fxf6-4fwr](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-r65f-fxf6-4fwr))
  - [High] Document-template renderer bypasses patient document and clinical-data permissions ([GHSA-vc2h-x8xf-8jcv](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-vc2h-x8xf-8jcv))
  - [High] Dynamic patient finder omits `patients/demo` ([GHSA-79g8-hm7q-xrh4](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-79g8-hm7q-xrh4))
  - [High] Five Module Manager actions run without the admin/manage_modules check ([GHSA-gpcx-xcp2-2rhx](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-gpcx-xcp2-2rhx))
  - [High] Incomplete Fix for CVE-2026-33910 Stored / Second-Order SQL Injection Still Reachable via `getByPatientDemographics()` in `library/patient.inc.php` ([GHSA-pc2q-9pcw-v899](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-pc2q-9pcw-v899))
  - [High] Low-privilege core users can replace arbitrary patient portal credentials ([GHSA-83hq-c876-fcwf](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-83hq-c876-fcwf))
  - [High] Low-privilege users can change another patient's tracker and appointment status ([GHSA-cxjf-fmpw-qc34](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-cxjf-fmpw-qc34))
  - [High] Missing authorization on portal/import_template.php allows any authenticated staff to wipe document-template profiles and read template bodies ([GHSA-phvv-q7m7-8mc2](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-phvv-q7m7-8mc2))
  - [High] No rate limiting or lockout on TOTP submission in web login and OAuth2 authorization code flows ([GHSA-rp7c-25mm-8g74](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-rp7c-25mm-8g74))
  - [High] OAuth2 clients not restricted to their registered grant types ([GHSA-qjj7-c4m9-6f92](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-qjj7-c4m9-6f92))
  - [High] OAuth2 Password Grant bypasses MFA when mfa_token parameter is omitted ([GHSA-6xc2-v6mv-w3g3](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/security/advisories/GHSA-6xc2-v6mv-w3g3)
